description: Build the adaptive study loop that turns generated questions into a personalized spaced-repetition / active-recall review engine ('help your brain remember' / 'web forming'). Uses an SM-2 style scheduler, adapts presentation and reinforcement to the user's LearningProfile, and surfaces a concept map linking related concepts. Then finalize project docs (README, Vercel deploy notes). Depends on FEAT-003 (questions) and FEAT-004 (profile).
steps: Create src/lib/study/scheduler.ts implementing an SM-2 style spaced-repetition algorithm: given a review card { easeFactor, interval, repetitions } and a recall grade (0-5), return the updated card and nextDueDate. Keep it pure and unit-testable.

Create src/lib/study/session.ts: build a study session for a user+book by selecting due cards (one card per generated question/concept), ordering and adapting them to the LearningProfile (e.g. surface conceptual/application prompts earlier for high 'kinesthetic/application' learners; adjust review interval multiplier from profile.preferredReviewInterval). Track mastery per concept.
Persist review state per user+book in the store (cards with SM-2 fields, last grade, due date, mastery level).

Create study API routes: GET /api/study/[bookId]/next (returns next due card + adaptive prompt), POST /api/study/[bookId]/grade (body { cardId, grade } updates SM-2 state and returns next card + updated mastery). Validate with zod and require an authenticated session.

Create src/lib/study/conceptMap.ts: derive a 'web' of related concepts from the BookAnalysis (link concepts sharing source chunks or curriculum topics) to visualize the 'web forming in your brain'. Return nodes+edges with per-concept mastery.

Build the study UI at src/app/study/[bookId]/page.tsx: an active-recall flashcard-style loop (show question, reveal answer, self-grade 0-5), a progress/mastery indicator, and a simple concept-map/web visualization of concepts colored by mastery. Reflect the user's dominant learning style in copy/presentation.

Add unit tests under src/lib/study/__tests__: SM-2 updates interval/easeFactor correctly for high vs low grades and increases interval over successful repetitions; session selection returns only due cards and respects profile adaptation; conceptMap produces edges between concepts that share sources.

Write README.md: project overview, the full user flow (register/login -> onboarding profile -> upload book -> analyze + curriculum -> high-probability questions -> adaptive spaced-repetition study), architecture summary, required env vars (OPENAI_API_KEY optional with mock fallback, AUTH_SECRET, LLM_PROVIDER), local dev commands (with the `source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22` note), test/build commands, Vercel deploy steps (set env vars in Vercel, note that local file/SQLite persistence is dev-only and production needs a hosted DB), and a clearly labeled 'MVP scope + roadmap / assumptions' section for future work (real DB, streaming AI, richer parsers, collaborative decks).
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/study/[bookId]/next returns a due card and POST .../grade updates its SM-2 state and returns the next card.
scheduler.ts: a high grade increases the interval and repetitions; a failing grade resets repetitions/interval (verified by unit tests).
Study session selection respects due dates and adapts ordering/interval to the LearningProfile (unit tested).
conceptMap returns edges linking concepts that share source chunks (unit tested).
README documents env vars, local run, tests, and Vercel deploy, plus an MVP scope + assumptions section.
All unit tests pass, `npm run build` succeeds keyless, and the end-to-end flow is navigable in `npm run dev`.

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && npm run lint

findings: Implemented the full adaptive study loop. The partial scheduler.ts left by the prior run was already a correct, pure SM-2 implementation, so it was reused as-is (no changes needed) and covered by new tests. New modules: src/lib/study/session.ts (deck build/reconcile, due-card selection, profile-adaptive ordering, interval multiplier from preferredReviewInterval, per-concept + overall mastery, gradeCard), src/lib/study/conceptMap.ts (concept web linking concepts by shared source chunks and curriculum co-occurrence), src/lib/study/prompt.ts (learning-style-aware adaptive prompts + defaultProfile for users who skipped onboarding), and src/lib/store/reviews.ts (in-memory ReviewStore singleton, same globalThis-cached pattern as book/user stores). API routes GET /api/study/[bookId]/next and POST /api/study/[bookId]/grade are session-gated, nodejs runtime, zod-validated; the next route also returns the concept graph. Study UI at src/app/study/[bookId]/page.tsx: active-recall flashcard loop, mastery bar, and an SVG concept web coloured by mastery; results applied inside async .then to satisfy react-hooks/set-state-in-effect, and navigation uses next/link. Added a 'Start study loop' link on the book page. README expanded with architecture, study-loop, Vercel deploy steps, and an 'MVP scope + roadmap / assumptions' section. Verification (Node 22 via nvm): npm test = 62 passed (13 files), typecheck clean, lint clean, build succeeds keyless with /study and /api/study routes registered.
